description: Zenodo publishes a global database of documented tsunami deposits assembled from the research literature. Its ZIP contains deposit locations, bibliographic and geomorphic attributes as KMZ, Shapefile and CSV files, plus forty raster-style map images. The repository states CC BY 4.0 and free public access. Deposit evidence can help locate past tsunami reach and test the geographic plausibility of coastal hazard scenarios for ports, settlements and flood defences. It is not a complete catalogue of every tsunami, a return-period model or an inundation raster. Preservation and study effort vary by coastline, and a deposit's mapped location need not mark the full inundation limit. Source citations and geological dating should be checked before using an observation to constrain a specific event. This dataset complements data-riesgos-state-dependent-tsunami-fragility, which addresses asset damage, not physical deposits. No ZIP was downloaded.
